title: Moderator role for roundtable — opens, guides, interjects, closes
description: Add explicit Moderator selection in launch wizard (default: Henry). Moderator responsibilities: opens session with agenda framing, can interject between any agent to keep discussion on track, doesn't wait for turn order, delivers final synthesis/conclusions, assigns action items. If Henry is in session he's auto-selected as moderator. If not, first agent or user's choice. Moderator speaks with a distinct framing: 'Let me redirect us...' / 'Good point, but we're drifting...' / 'Let me summarize where we are...'
